race.name: Legendaria Gran Fondo Ontinyent
race.tagline: A 180.6-kilometer second-edition Spanish gran fondo with 2,632 meters of climbing and El Campello waiting late.

vitals.field_size: No maximum field published in the official regulations
vitals.start_format: 07:30 mass start inside a traffic-controlled safety capsule
vitals.registration: RockTheSport; RFEC or UCI license required, with a one-day license available
vitals.entry_fee: EUR 50 through January 15, EUR 55 through March 15, and EUR 60 in the final published tier, plus platform fee
vitals.feed_zones: Four strategically placed feed zones are advertised; exact locations are published with the route map
vitals.cutoff_time: 14:00 at Moixent for access to the Alt del Campello section; later riders follow the El Bosquet and Portixol alternative
route_options: Gran Fondo Legendaria: 180.6 km / 2,632 m / five climbs via Alt del Campello
Gran Fondo El Bosquet: 179.7 km / 2,539 m / five climbs
Medio Fondo Les Alcusses: 123.6 km / 1,596 m / three climbs

climate.description: A mid-April start reduces peak-summer heat, but a long inland Valencia route still rewards flexible clothing and disciplined hydration.

terrain.primary: Long, paved Spanish gran fondo with five climbs
terrain.surface: Paved roads through inland Valencia and Alicante under Spanish traffic law and the event's protected race capsule.

fondo_rating.scoring_notes: The long route, five climbs, protected race capsule, strong published services, low entry fee, and confirmed elite guests are legitimate strengths. It remains a second-edition regional event, so prestige and cultural impact stay deliberately low.

climb_profile.king_of_mountain: Alt del Campello, accessed after the 14:00 Moixent cutoff

course_description.character: The main route covers 180.6 kilometers and 2,632 meters of climbing across inland Valencia and Alicante. Riders pass the Moixent control before the late Alt del Campello section, then continue toward Portixol and the Ontinyent finish. The organizer provides two alternative distances without turning the flagship route into an ultra.
course_description.signature_challenge: Reaching Moixent before 14:00 with enough left for the late Alt del Campello and Portixol sequence.

logistics.airport: Ontinyent is an inland regional destination; verify current rail, road, and airport connections before booking.
logistics.lodging_strategy: Use the organizer's partner-accommodation list in Ontinyent; the event advertises a 15 percent participant discount with listed bike-friendly properties.
logistics.transport: Friday expo and bib pickup run in Ontinyent, with final pickup from 06:00 to 07:00 before the 07:30 Saturday start.
logistics.food: Entry includes on-course supplies and a post-race paella; the expo also advertises food trucks.

history.origin_story: The Ontinyent event returns for its second edition in 2027 with three routes and a more developed expo and support program.
history.reputation: A new regional Spanish gran fondo with an unusually complete published rulebook, attractive pricing, and recognizable invited riders, but almost no long-term history yet.

biased_opinion.verdict: Excellent Value, Still Earning Its Name
biased_opinion.summary: The organizer has published more useful operational detail than many established events: exact routes, a real cutoff, protected-race procedures, support, entry tiers, and post-race food. The skepticism belongs around longevity, not the substance of the day.
strengths: Jersey and post-race meal included at a low published fee
weaknesses: Regional prestige rather than bucket-list status
biased_opinion.bottom_line: A high-value Spanish spring race with enough distance and climbing to justify a dedicated build, graded for what is verified rather than what its name promises.

final_verdict.one_liner: A 180.6-kilometer second-edition Spanish gran fondo with 2,632 meters of climbing and El Campello waiting late.
final_verdict.should_you_race: Yes if you value a hard, well-supported route and strong inclusions over international prestige; wait if you want years of execution history.
final_verdict.alternatives: Marcha Cicloturista Valencia for a more established regional event, or Gran Fondo Alberto Contador for a stronger champion-led identity.
